accepted.quote: Because racial discrimination is rarely explicit, identifying potential cases of discrimination by analyzing their impact--rather than just their motive--was critical to the enforcement of civil rights protections.
accepted.rationale: The quote affirms disparate-impact analysis as critical to enforcing civil rights protections.
